bounded_scope: Contrastive pilot for modern standard Japanese structural risks; no independent authority to approve Japanese publication.
nonessentialist_limit: A typological stress test for topic, ellipsis, viewpoint, honorificity and SOV organization, not a description of every speaker or Japanese society.

ordinary_discourse: reference-grammar descriptions of particles, argument omission, sentence-final stance and register
literary_calibration: not implemented as an author model; any Japanese literary asset requires work-specific expert review

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Topic marking and case marking jointly organize information; topic is not identical to subject.
Voice, causative, lexical choice and omission adjust agency.
counterexamples_and_variation: experimental task effects do not define social responsibility

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Past/nonpast and aspectual constructions interact with verb class and context.
transformation_risks: ている mapped uniformly to progressive

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Sentence-final, reportative, appearance and quotation forms mark source and stance.
Contextually recoverable arguments are widely omitted and viewpoint constrains zero reference.
transformation_risks: one person supplied for multiple zero arguments

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Conjunctive and nonfinite forms, nominalization and sentence-final completion build clause relations.
Verbs, compounds and adjuncts distribute manner, path and result.
open_questions: insufficient evidence for general cognitive effect

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Narrow canonical SOV combines with topic-first tendencies, focus marking and constrained scrambling.
Honorific, benefactive and address choices can encode social relation and viewpoint.
counterexamples_and_variation: professional, ironic and strategic uses vary

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Counters, mimetics, borrowing and register-specific lexicon choose granularity.
transformation_risks: lexical nuance treated as essential category

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Sentence-final accumulation, particles, prosody and punctuation organize breathing.
Plain/polite, spoken/written and literary registers have distinct options.
open_questions: no Japanese literary publication gate in this pilot

inbound_outbound_summary: Never supply referents for omitted arguments without provenance or residue.
Preserve sentence-final evidential, modal and social information when translating to Chinese or English.
Formal Japanese publication requires native and source-specific review beyond this profile.
